# A file path into a nested replacement module must resolve using that module,
# not the replacement module containing its directory.
cd m
go list ../a
stdout '^example.com/a$'
go list ../a/b
stdout '^example.com/b$'
go list ../a/b/c
stdout '^example.com/b/c$'
go list $GOPATH/src/a/b
stdout '^example.com/b$'

# Also check the pruned module graph.
go mod edit -go=1.17
go list ../a/b
stdout '^example.com/b$'
go list ../a/b/c
stdout '^example.com/b/c$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.16

require (
	example.com/a v0.0.0
	example.com/b v0.0.0
)

replace (
	example.com/a => ../a
	example.com/b => ../a/b
)
-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/a

go 1.16
-- a/a.go --
package a
-- a/b/go.mod --
module example.com/b

go 1.16
-- a/b/b.go --
package b
-- a/b/c/c.go --
package c
